```{r doc-code, include=FALSE}
source("../code/R/doc_code.R")
```

All panels are produced by
[`script/FigureS7.R`](https://github.com/dzemmour/immgenT-cosmo-analysis/blob/main/script/FigureS7.R).
The code below is shown for reference (not re-executed on this page); the
images are its pre-rendered output.

To simulate mapping of novel T-cell states, individual CD4 reference clusters
were removed from the immgenT reference in turn, and cells belonging to the
omitted cluster were mapped back as query cells using T-RBI. Results were
compared with mapping against the complete, non-ablated reference.

Panel **S7d** shows single-cell discovery scores for cells from each omitted
cluster, with and without ablation. The cached ablation objects were reduced to
the assignment and confidence columns and do not retain the discovery score, so
the panel is not reproduced here.

## Setup

```{r figs7-setup, code=code_for("../script/FigureS7.R", c("^", "Load data")), eval=FALSE}
```

## (A) Omitted-cluster cells on the ablated CD4 MDE {#figs7a}

```{r figs7a-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS7.R", "S7a"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs7a-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="24%"}
knitr::include_graphics(sort(list.files("assets/ExtendedDataFigure7",
                                        pattern = "^S7a_", full.names = TRUE)))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 7A.** CD4 MDEs showing the positions of query cells from
each omitted cluster after T-RBI against the ablated reference. Query cells map
predominantly to the region occupied by the corresponding cluster in the
complete reference — shown in white against the rest of the CD4 reference in
black — thereby filling the "hole" created by its removal.
:::

## (B) Cluster assignments after ablation {#figs7b}

```{r figs7b-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS7.R", "S7b"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs7b-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="80%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure7/S7b_ablation_confusion_matrix.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 7B.** T-RBI cluster assignments of cells from each omitted
cluster. Rows indicate the original cluster and columns the assigned cluster
after ablation; dot size and colour indicate the proportion of cells receiving
each assignment. Values in the "not classified" column give the percentage of
cells remaining unannotated. Reported before fine-tuning, which is the
conservative reading.
:::

## (C) Confidence scores for misclassified cells {#figs7c}

```{r figs7c-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS7.R", "S7c"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs7c-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="90%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure7/S7c_ablation_confidence_scores.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 7C.** T-RBI annotation confidence scores for cells
misclassified after ablation, shown before and after annotation fine-tuning and
compared with scores for the same cells mapped to the complete reference
without ablation. If two neighbouring clusters were an arbitrary split of one
state, removing one should reassign its cells to the other at undiminished
confidence; the drop shown here is evidence that they are distinct.
:::
